sourceMetadata.sourceTitle: AITA for telling my mom she's a bad parent
sourceMetadata.whyUnprimed: The post presents both past parental conduct and current controlling/anxious behavior without telling the bot which side to blame.
route: Minor/dependent role and current home-safety assessment.
Current-reality lane: past unreliability, present communication, and current parental responsibilities.
Certainty/accommodation lane: predictable notice may be reasonable support; hiding keys and surveillance may also maintain/control the problem.
Do not place the full burden of obtaining treatment on a minor.
Identify safe adults/school/health supports and a family plan that reduces uncertainty without granting total control.
sourceMetadata.defectFound: The first revised maps did not specify how to balance reasonable caregiver predictability with accommodation of escalating control in a minor.
sourceMetadata.implementedImprovement: Map 14 is extended below with a minor/dependent section that separates guardian duties, proportionate accommodation, and age-appropriate autonomy.
